description: List the workspace's agent inboxes, ordered by address, 50 to a page. Send `domainId` or `label` to list only one domain's or one group's inboxes, `q` for the start of an address, or `ids` for the inboxes you already know (up to 100). Each one has its `id` (the one list_threads takes as `mailboxId`), `address`, `domainId`, `displayName`, `label` and `paused`. A deleted inbox is not listed. A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes lists only the inboxes it reads.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

domainId.description: Only inboxes on this mail domain.

ids.description: Only these inboxes, up to 100. Repeat it to name several. An id that is no inbox of yours is left out.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

q.description: The start of an address: sup finds support@agents.acme.com.

name: list_agent_inboxes
title: List the agent inboxes
